sql.value: select m.id, p.provider_type, m.model_name, p.api_key, p.api_base_url, m.default_size, m.is_default, m.enable_status, m.sort, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.is_deleted, m.revision from ai_model m left join ai_model_provider p on p.id = m.provider_id where m.is_deleted=0 and m.model_type = 'image' #[and p.provider_type = :providerType] #[and m.model_name like :modelName] #[and m.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by m.sort desc, m.id desc
